items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: We had to get somebody else, which we got Mr. Professor Cleven Williams. He stayed about six months with us.

ctx.x: Back to the music business. How did you get started? Were any of your family musicals that helped you out?

No one. Like I said, the other night, a bunch of boys got together and started a little band, organized a little band, and we bought some instruments, and I had an instrument. Like I said, the first day I had my instrument, I could play in tune. From that we began to take lessons from Mr. John Robichaud. He came out here for about six months. Then he discontinued.
